title: bot.ability.listening.sensitivity.score
description: Private listening request preserving the environment sound that must be scored.

event.description: Canonical HSM event name that emitted this upstream payload.
event.title: Event

data.description: Complete typed payload emitted by the upstream event.

audio.description: Reference (a URI reference) to the audio this stimulus carries; floppy passes media by reference, never as bytes [floppy field].
audio.title: Audio

media_type.description: Optional media type or codec label, such as audio/pcm or audio/opus.
media_type.title: Media Type

sample_rate_hz.description: Optional sample rate for raw or decoded audio, measured in hertz.
sample_rate_hz.title: Sample Rate Hz

channels.description: Optional number of audio channels represented by the chunk.
channels.title: Channels

kind.description: Optional low-cardinality acoustic provenance hint. Prefer domain-qualified labels when the source is clear (for example phone.ringing, phone.call, ambient, knock) so models do not confuse bare tokens like ring. Not a linguistic interpretation.
kind.title: Kind

amplitude_db.description: Optional loudness of this sound at its source, in dB SPL measured one metre away. A shout and a whisper leave the same mouth, so loudness belongs to the sound rather than to the thing that made it. How far it carries is the environment's to work out; omitting this means the sound reaches every listener regardless of distance.
amplitude_db.title: Amplitude Db

received_level_db.description: Optional loudness of this sound in dB SPL where the recipient of this event is, which is a different quantity from amplitude_db: the same shout is one level at the mouth and another at the far side of the room. The environment fills this in per recipient, so an emitter never sets it. None means the environment had nothing to measure — the sound carried no amplitude, or nobody said where it or the listener was — not that the sound was silent.
received_level_db.title: Received Level Db

source.description: Optional acoustic source: the transducer this sound came off, as its emitter stamps it (speaking stamps its mouth, "speaking", the mouth its efference copy names). The original carries it as the sound event's source; an SCXML event relayed through the body keeps only its data, so floppy carries it in the sound [floppy field]. Listening scores an arrival against an efference copy only when this is the producing mouth; a sound without one is never the bot's own.
source.title: Source

data.title: SoundData

id.description: Upstream HSM event correlation id, when the emitter stamped one.
id.title: Id

source.description: Upstream HSM event source identity, when stamped by its producer.
source.title: Source

target.description: Upstream HSM event target identity, when stamped for delivery.
target.title: Target

stimulus.title: StimulusData[SoundData]
stimulus.description: Exact environment sound request being scored, including the acoustic source needed to compare an arrival with the currently producing mouth.
